primary_sources.title: Autosomal recessive cortical myoclonic tremor and epilepsy: association with a mutation in the potassium channel associated gene CNTN2.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected cache remains abstract-only. An authentic author-uploaded original PDF supplied complete Methods/Results and the first Discussion section on printed pages1156–1159; the remainder and supplement were not inspected. The exact presynaptic-organization supporting relationship remains unresolved, not the identity of the paper.

primary_sources.title: Inhibitory axons are targeted in hippocampal cell culture by anti-Caspr2 autoantibodies associated with limbic encephalitis.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected complete Methods, target Results and Discussion read. Human construct, rat hippocampal cultures and mouse knockout/rescue are distinguished. Patient anti-Caspr2 effects are not transferred to CNTN2.

primary_sources.title: Interactome Mapping Provides a Network of Neurodegenerative Disease Proteins and Uncovers Widespread Protein Aggregation in Affected Brains.
primary_sources.read_scope: Complete abstract and three literal IntAct assay records read, including feature and role fields. No full-paper or native-complex claim; this is not the separate HuRI publication.

primary_sources.title: cDNA cloning, structural features, and eucaryotic expression of human TAG-1/axonin-1.
primary_sources.read_scope: Complete abstract read; original full text remained unavailable after bounded publisher and repository attempts. Human constructs in COS1/myeloma cells are distinguished from host species. Adhesion retention also uses independent later assays.

primary_sources.title: Molecular mechanism of contactin 2 homophilic interaction.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected complete Methods/Results/Discussion read. Soluble HighFive-produced ectodomains and tagged mammalian-cell adhesion constructs are distinct; cross-linking used for structural particles is recorded. No raw-map or figure-pixel reanalysis.

primary_sources.title: Cryo-EM structures of the full-length human contactin-2.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected complete Methods/Results/captions read. Purified residues29–1012 and tagged surface constructs are distinguished; the title does not make the purified ectodomain an intact GPI-anchored membrane protein. Concentration-dependent association does not establish universal native dimer stoichiometry.

primary_sources.title: The crystal structure of the ligand-binding module of human TAG-1 suggests a new mode of homophilic interaction.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected Methods/Results/Discussion read. Refolded bacterial residues28–418 and lattice-contact inference are distinguished from the later directly tested Ig3–Ig6 adhesion interface.

primary_sources.title: Juxtaparanodal clustering of Shaker-like K+ channels in myelinated axons depends on Caspr2 and TAG-1.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected Methods/Results/Discussion read. Direct protein immunostaining is distinguished from tau-lacZ node/myelin reporter staining; model geometry is not treated as a solved native structure.

primary_sources.title: Association of TAG-1 with Caspr2 is essential for the molecular organization of juxtaparanodal regions of myelinated fibers.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected Methods/Results read. Rat TAG-1/human CASPR2 cis assays and explicitly human TAG-1 Fc-binding constructs are distinguished from mouse nerves. The cellular data resolve accumulation, not a transport-versus-retention mechanism.

primary_sources.title: The expression of TAG-1 in glial cells is sufficient for the formation of the juxtaparanodal complex and the phenotypic rescue of tag-1 homozygous mutants in the CNS.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected complete Methods/Results/Discussion read. Rat transgene, mouse tissues, myelin fractionation and glial surface labeling are explicit. Ectopic PNS localization fails to rescue; CNS sufficiency is not generalized to all nerves.

primary_sources.title: Structural requirement of TAG-1 for retinal ganglion cell axons and myelin in the mouse optic nerve.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected complete Methods/Results/Discussion read. Human purified TAG-1 and human TAX-expressing cells are tested with mouse retinal explants; knockout optic-nerve phenotypes are mouse. Astroglial morphology need not imply a direct cytoskeletal activity.

primary_sources.title: Lewis(x) and alpha2,3-sialyl glycans and their receptors TAG-1, Contactin, and L1 mediate CD24-dependent neurite outgrowth.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected Methods/Results read. Human transfected CHO lysate pull-down has BSA and carbohydrate controls; purified TAX-Fc/CD24 binding and mouse neural outgrowth assays are separate. No purified human affinity value is asserted.

primary_sources.title: The juxtaparanodal proteins CNTNAP2 and TAG1 regulate diet-induced obesity.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected complete Methods/Results read. Whole-body adiposity is not adipocyte differentiation, and the specific normal-gene reduction-of-feeding mechanism remains unresolved.

primary_sources.title: Postsynaptic density-93 clusters Kv1 channels at axon initial segments independently of Caspr2.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected Methods/Results/Discussion read. The original rat assay is distinguished from current mouse GOA provenance; the PSD-93 clustering mechanism is not assigned to TAG-1.

primary_sources.title: Molecular cytogenetic analysis and resequencing of contactin associated protein-like 2 in autism spectrum disorders.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected normal cache is abstract-only. Genuine external PMC2253974 text and Figure3D legend with fractionation and antibody methods were read. The CNTNAP2-focused paper directly assays TAG-1; cofractionation is not binding proof.

primary_sources.title: Distribution of TAG-1/axonin-1 in fibre tracts and migratory streams of the developing mouse nervous system.
primary_sources.read_scope: Complete genuine abstract read; full text not inspected. The explicit developmental protein-localization observations support the narrow positive use.

primary_sources.title: The neural adhesion molecule TAG-1 modulates responses of sensory axons to diffusible guidance signals.
primary_sources.read_scope: Complete genuine abstract read; full text not inspected. The abstract explicitly describes knockout axons and receptor-complex endocytosis; finer assay details are not asserted.

primary_sources.title: Dendrite branching and self-avoidance are controlled by Turtle, a conserved IgSF protein in Drosophila.
primary_sources.read_scope: Complete genuine abstract read as donor grounding only. It is not evidence of a direct human CNTN2 experiment or a reconstruction of the PAINT node.

primary_sources.title: DSCAM and DSCAML1 function in self-avoidance in multiple cell types in the developing mouse retina.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected complete Methods/Results/Discussion read. This is named donor evidence, not a transfer of all DSCAM signaling mechanisms to GPI-anchored CNTN2.

primary_sources.title: Amyloid precursor protein dimerization and synaptogenic function depend on copper binding to the growth factor-like domain.
primary_sources.read_scope: Selected complete Methods/Results read for partner-class adjudication. APP ectodomain bead aggregation and heterologous cell-contact assays do not establish the physiological function of the screened APP–CNTN2 pair.

external_18179895.scope: Original Fig.3D legend and target text; rat TAG-1 is physically detected in synaptic plasma-membrane fractions. Normal abstract is unchanged.
